title: 交易心理 | 止损不是认错，是给下一笔机会买的门票
subTitle:
很多人止损下不去手，是因为把止损当成了「我错了」的证明，自尊心
过不去。换个角度想：止损是你提前买好的保险，保费就是那一小笔亏损。
职业玩家和赌徒的区别，不是谁更准，而是谁允许自己错。

我见过最稳的交易者，错起来比谁都干脆。因为他知道：这一笔的对错
不重要，一百笔下来的期望值才重要。下一次止损手抖的时候，对自己
说一句：这是门票，不是判决书。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t Admitting You’re Wrong—it’s the Price of Admission for Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to pull the trigger on a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you buy in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I’ve ever seen cuts losses more decisively than anyone. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. Next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
this: It’s the price of admission, not a verdict.

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum (ETH) Market: Weak, Range-Bound Trading Amid Multiple Negative Catalysts

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of 3:00 p.m. Beijing time on November 28, Ethereum was trading at $1,655, down approximately 4.5% over the past 24 hours—a significantly larger decline than Bitcoin’s. After opening near $1,666, the price continued to fall, reaching a low of $1,640 before moving in a narrow range at lower levels. On the hourly chart, the bodies of the past five candlesticks have gradually narrowed, with alternating upper and lower wicks. This indicates intense competition between buyers and sellers at lower levels, though sellers still have a slight edge.

Ethereum’s recent weakness is linked to several negative factors piling up. First, spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $69.4 million in net outflows on November 27, extending the trend of institutional funds withdrawing. Second, the strategic reserve wallet of the World Liberty project sold 12,121 ETH, cashing out approximately $20 million and realizing a loss of nearly $19.3 million. This large sale directly triggered a rapid price decline, while the WLFI token itself plunged to a record low of $0.026.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

Regarding moving averages, the 7-period moving average is at $1,660, below the 25-period moving average at $1,679, with the short-term averages diverging downward. The 99-period moving average is at $1,684, putting overhead pressure on the price. The three moving averages show a typical bearish alignment. In the short term, the price needs to hold above $1,680 to restore bullish confidence.

The MACD indicator shows the DIFF line at -11.12, the DEA line at -11.00, and the histogram at -0.12. The histogram’s negative value is narrowing rapidly, indicating that downward momentum is fading. The 6-period RSI is at 33.71, deep in oversold territory. Historical data shows that when Ethereum’s 6-period RSI falls below 35, a technical rebound often follows in the short term. For the KDJ indicator, the K value is 49.04, the D value is 46.38, and the J value is 54.38. The J line has turned upward first, hinting at a possible short-term golden cross.

The Bollinger Bands show an upper band at $1,695, a middle band at $1,667, and a lower band at $1,638. The price is currently trading below the middle band, with only about $17 separating it from the lower band. If the price falls below the lower band at $1,638, it could trigger an accelerated decline toward the $1,600 round-number level. However, given that the RSI is already in oversold territory and the MACD histogram is narrowing, the likelihood of a technical rebound is increasing.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Market sentiment surrounding Ethereum is currently mixed. On one hand, continued institutional outflows and large whale sales have clearly fueled fear in the market. On the other hand, the upcoming Glamsterdam storage fee upgrade has raised concerns in the technical community. More than 200 issues involving software and smart contracts have been identified on-chain. If they are not fixed before the testnet deployment on December 15, the upgrade could be affected. In addition, an attack on the Chainflip bridging protocol resulted in the theft of $12.6 million worth of Ethereum and Bitcoin, undermining confidence in the cross-chain ecosystem.

On the positive side, Ethereum’s composite indicator signals remain bullish, with a historical win rate of approximately 73.68%. The current price is already close to the lower Bollinger Band, and several oversold indicators suggest that conditions for a rebound are maturing. If positive macroeconomic catalysts emerge—for example, the Federal Reserve sends dovish signals or ETF flows turn positive—Ethereum could see a recovery rally. Investors should closely monitor the support between $1,630 and $1,640, as well as resistance at the $1,700 level.

以太坊ETH市场深度分析：多重利空叠加下的弱势震荡

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月二十八日下午三点，以太坊现货价格报一千六百五十五美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之四点五，跌幅明显大于比特币。价格从一千六百六十六美元附近开盘后持续走低，最低触及一千六百四十美元，随后在低位窄幅震荡。从小时K线来看，过去五根K线的实体逐渐缩小，上下影线交替出现，显示多空双方在低位展开了激烈博弈，但空方仍略占上风。

以太坊近期的弱势表现与多重利空因素叠加有关。首先，现货以太坊ETF在十一月二十七日录得六千九百四十万美元的净流出，延续了机构资金持续撤离的趋势。其次，World Liberty项目的战略储备钱包抛售了一万两千一百二十一枚以太坊，套现约两千万美元，实际亏损接近一千九百三十万美元。这一大额抛售直接触发了价格的快速下跌，WLFI代币本身也暴跌至零点零二六美元的历史新低。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线报一千六百六十美元，已跌破二十五周期均线的一千六百七十九美元，短期均线向下发散。九十九周期均线位于一千六百八十四美元，对价格形成上方压制。三条均线呈现典型的空头排列格局，短期内价格需要站稳一千六百八十美元才能恢复多头信心。

MACD指标显示DIFF线报负十一点一二，DEA线报负十一点零零，柱状图为负零点一二。柱状图的负值正在快速收窄，显示下跌动能正在衰竭。RSI六周期指标报三十三点七一，已深入超卖区域。回顾历史数据，以太坊RSI六跌破三十五后往往会在短期内出现技术性反弹。KDJ指标中K值四十九点零四、D值四十六点三八、J值五十四点三八，J线率先向上拐头，暗示短期可能出现金叉信号。

布林带指标显示上轨一千六百九十五美元，中轨一千六百六十七美元，下轨一千六百三十八美元。价格目前在中轨下方运行，距离下轨仅约十七美元的空间。如果价格跌破下轨一千六百三十八美元，可能触发加速下跌至一千六百美元整数关口。但考虑到RSI已经处于超卖区域，且MACD柱状图正在收窄，技术性反弹的概率在增加。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场情绪较为复杂。一方面，机构资金的持续流出和大额鲸鱼抛售给市场带来了明显的恐慌情绪。另一方面，即将到来的Glamsterdam存储费升级引发了技术社区的担忧，链上已发现超过两百个软件和智能合约问题，如果在十二月十五日测试网部署前未能修复，可能影响升级的顺利进行。此外，Chainflip桥接协议被攻击导致一千二百六十万美元的以太坊和比特币被盗，也打击了跨链生态的信心。

不过从积极的角度来看，以太坊综合指标信号仍为做多，历史胜率约为百分之七十三点六八。当前价格已经接近布林带下轨，且多个超卖指标暗示反弹条件正在成熟。如果宏观层面出现利好催化，例如美联储释放鸽派信号或ETF资金流向转正，以太坊有望迎来一波修复性行情。投资者应密切关注一千六百三十美元至一千六百四十美元区间的支撑有效性，以及一千七百美元关口的压力。

This suggests that although short-term sentiment is pessimistic, long-term holders are using the pullback to build positions. Overall, Bitcoin is in an oversold phase dominated by bears. 比特币BTC市场深度分析：空头主导下的超卖博弈

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月二十八日下午三点，比特币现货价格报五万九千七百三十五美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之三点一。价格从六万美元上方快速滑落，最低触及五万九千一百八十八美元，随后小幅反弹至当前水平。从K线形态来看，过去五根小时线呈现明显的震荡下行格局，每根K线的上影线较短而下影线偏长，说明多方在低位有一定承接力量，但整体空头仍占据主导地位。

从更宏观的视角来看，比特币在十一月份经历了持续的资金外流压力。美国现货比特币ETF已经连续八天出现净流出，十一月份累计流出规模达到五十三点九亿美元，创下历史最差月度纪录。这一数据反映出机构投资者在当前价位选择了减仓而非加仓，对市场情绪构成了显著压制。与此同时，恐惧与贪婪指数跌至十一的极低水平，表明市场参与者普遍处于恐慌状态。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，七周期均线报五万九千八百六十六美元，已跌破二十五周期均线的六万零二百八十九美元，形成了短期均线下穿长期均线的死叉信号。九十九周期均线位于六万零一百七十九美元，同样对价格构成上方压力。三条均线呈空头排列，短期内价格需要有效突破六万美元才能扭转弱势格局。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线报负二百四十五点七一，DEA线报负二百四十三点八八，柱状图为负一点八三。虽然柱状图的负值在逐步收窄，显示下跌动能有所减弱，但DIFF和DEA均处于零轴下方，空头趋势尚未结束。RSI六周期指标报三十七点一六，已进入超卖区域，但尚未出现明显的底背离信号。KDJ指标中K值四十八点七一、D值四十八点四七、J值四十九点二零，三线粘合于中位区域，暗示短期方向选择临近。

布林带指标显示上轨六万零七百三十八美元，中轨五万九千九百四十五美元，下轨五万九千一百五十二美元。价格目前运行在中轨与下轨之间，接近下轨位置，存在一定的技术性反弹需求。但布林带开口仍在扩大，意味着波动性尚未收敛，价格可能继续在下轨附近寻求支撑。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

My observation is that the real significance of Vitalik’s statement this time lies not in whether the complaints are justified, but in its attempt to recast the externalities of hard forks from “applications adapting on their own” to a social norm that “core developers have a responsibility to help.” This judgment holds only if subsequent fork discussions genuinely proceed according to this norm, rather than stopping at verbal commitments.

According to a November 28 report by PANews, Vitalik said that complaints about some contracts becoming invalid due to EIP-8037 are reasonable and justified. He believes EIP-8037 and several subsequent major breaking changes are necessary for Ethereum’s long-term health, but that such deep modifications should not be pushed through lightly. He supports establishing a social norm under which core developers have at least a responsibility to help applications upgrade when they are affected by a hard fork and had previously had good reason to believe the relevant features were stable. Given the disruptive nature of the changes, the Glamsterdam upgrade should not be rushed.

On closer inspection, this touches on a longstanding issue with ETH’s upgrade process: the protocol layer pursues long-term health, while the costs often fall first on the application layer. In the past, these costs were generally treated as applications’ own responsibility to adapt. Vitalik’s statement amounts to an acknowledgment that this allocation is not always fair. My observation is that once “a responsibility to help” becomes a norm, an additional social-consensus threshold will apply to moving forward with forks. Vitalik admits it: The complaints about EIP-8037 are justified. Why rush Glamsterdam?

Vitalik responded to developers’ dissatisfaction with EIP-8037, acknowledging that the problem is real and that Glamsterdam shouldn’t be rushed.

According to Binance Square, Vitalik directly addressed the controversy sparked by EIP-8037. Some contracts stopped working because of this protocol change, and developers are right to complain—he acknowledged that. But he also drew a line: Ethereum can’t recommend that every application keep a centralized upgrade backdoor just to accommodate legacy contracts. That would mean selling out decentralization. He stressed that the fork changed things applications had assumed were stable, and core developers have a responsibility to continue supporting affected projects—and to step up that support. As for a more disruptive upgrade like Glamsterdam, his position is clear: don’t rush it. Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.

In a nutshell: This isn’t about passing the buck to application developers. The core team is taking responsibility and committing to provide support.

Impact on the market
- Short term: Sentiment is broadly neutral. Vitalik admitting fault and promising support has eased tensions in parts of the developer community, but it doesn’t change ETH’s current weak price trend at $1,656 (24h -4.51%). Good news can’t rescue the price.
- Medium term: This statement effectively sets a boundary for Ethereum’s roadmap: it would rather make upgrades slower and more difficult than open the door to centralized backdoors. It’s reassuring for long-term believers, but another disappointment for those who think Ethereum is too slow.

🎯 My take
Honestly, this isn’t much of a short-term catalyst for the token price; it’s a statement about technical community governance. But its long-term significance outweighs any short-term price signal: the core team’s willingness to support applications and reject centralized compromises is one of Ethereum’s most valuable moats. Slowing down Glamsterdam cools near-term upgrade expectations but strengthens the long-term narrative. I’m 60% confident in this assessment; I’ll leave the other 40% to the market. If I’m wrong, go easy on me.

Vitalik认了：EIP-8037的抱怨是合理的，Glamsterdam凭什么不能赶工？

Vitalik回应开发者对EIP-8037的不满，承认问题真实存在，Glamsterdam不应操之过急。

据Binance Square消息，Vitalik正面回应了EIP-8037引发的争议。有些合约因为这次协议变更直接跑不动了，开发者抱怨这是有道理的，他认。但他同时划了条线：以太坊不能为了照顾旧合约，就建议所有应用留一个中心化的升级后门——那等于把去中心化的底线给卖了。他强调，分叉改变了应用原本认为稳定的东西，核心开发者有责任持续支援受影响的项目，而且这种支援还要加强。至于Glamsterdam这种破坏性较大的升级，他的态度很明确：别赶工，慢就是快。

一句话翻译：这次不是甩锅给应用开发者，而是核心层自己认账、自己兜底。

对市场的影响
- 短期：情绪层面偏中性。V神认错+承诺支援，缓和了部分开发者社区的紧张，但不改变ETH当下 $1,656（24h -4.51%）的弱势走势，消息面救不了价格面。
- 中期：这条表态其实是给以太坊的路线划定边界——宁可升级慢一点、难一点，也不给中心化后门开口子。对长期主义者是定心丸，对嫌以太坊慢的人是又一次失望。

🎯 我的判断
说实话，这事对币价没什么短期催化，纯技术社区治理层面的表态。但它的长期意义比短期价格信号大：核心层愿意为应用兜底、拒绝中心化妥协，是以太坊最值钱的护城河之一。Glamsterdam放缓意味着短期升级预期降温，长期叙事更稳。这判断我有六成把握，剩下四成交给市场，说错轻喷。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

The term “rolling positions” has been trending lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, then roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original capital. Today, let’s talk about what those stories don’t tell you.

【What Rolling Positions Involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It's basically using the market's money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, those unrealized gains
can go from dozens of points up to zero in just one or two big down candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of rolling positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If you have a 60% win rate each time, the chance of getting it right four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

📰 Shanghai Data Center Found Stockpiling Nvidia’s Top-Tier Chips—Who Exactly Are U.S. Export Controls Stopping?

According to Crypto Briefing, a data center in Shanghai was found to be in possession of Nvidia’s most advanced AI chips, with the parties involved reportedly linked to Alice Huang. Put simply, a potential loophole has emerged in the export controls the U.S. has been so determined to enforce—the restricted top-tier chips may have made it through the controls and into China. This is a sensitive variable for Nvidia, the U.S.-China tech rivalry, and the crypto computing-power market alike.

In-Depth Analysis

Why does this news matter?

The crux of this issue isn’t what chips one data center is using; it’s that a crack has appeared in the “global computing-power wall” created by export controls. The tighter the restrictions, the more strategic computing power becomes; and the more visible the cracks, the more likely the U.S. response will be to come down hard—with stricter reviews and more complex compliance chains, ultimately driving up global computing costs. For the crypto market, this is tied to both BTC hashrate and the mining hardware supply chain. BTC itself has also been trading weakly around $59,604.4, down 3.46% over 24 hours, leaving the market on edge. Any macro headwind is likely to be magnified.

In a nutshell: a hole has been torn in chip controls. In the short term, this isn’t a win for anyone—it’s more likely to bring even tighter restrictions.

Market Impact

Here’s how the chain of events could play out: export-control loophole exposed → U.S. tightens policy → tech stocks come under pressure → risk appetite falls → altcoins and crypto markets pull back together. The NVDA ecosystem is an anchor for the global AI narrative. When that anchor wobbles, it’s hard for high-beta assets like crypto to escape the fallout. ETH is down 4.75% over 24 hours and SOL is down 2.57%. The entire market is already falling, and this news is effectively handing bears more ammunition.

Historically, whenever U.S.-China tech restrictions have escalated—through bans, investigations, or rumors of sanctions—the odds of a short-term BTC drop have been far from low. The market was already weak this time around, and bearish sentiment is plain to see.

To put it bluntly, I’m not bullish at this level. With BTC at $59,604.4, before a clear direction emerges, any bad regulatory news is likely to affect prices more than good news. I’m leaning toward cautious observation. If we see a high-volume rebound over the next 12–24 hours that recovers lost ground, that would suggest the negative news has been absorbed. If prices keep sliding, this will be another heavy blow from the bears. Go easy on me if I’m wrong—I’m only testing the waters with a small position myself.

📰 上海数据中心被发现囤着英伟达顶级芯片，美国出口管制到底卡住了谁？

据 Crypto Briefing 报道，上海一家数据中心被发现持有英伟达最高端AI芯片，且相关方被指向 Alice Huang。说白了，就是美国严防死守的出口管制出现了潜在漏洞——禁售的顶级芯片疑似绕过管制落地。这对英伟达、中美科技博弈和加密算力市场都是敏感变量。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？

这件事的本质不是一家机房用了什么芯片，而是出口管制这个"全球算力隔离墙"出现了裂缝。管制越严，说明算力越是战略资源；而裂缝越明显，美方后续的监管反应大概率越强硬——更严的审查、更复杂的合规链条，最终会推高全球算力成本。对币圈来说，这和BTC算力、矿机供应链都沾边，而且最近BTC本身就在 $59,604.4 弱势震荡，24小时跌3.46%，市场神经紧绷，任何宏观利空都会被放大解读。

一句话翻译：芯片管制的口子被撕开，短期不是利好谁，而是招来更严的锁。

对市场的影响

推演一下链路：管制漏洞曝光 → 美方收紧政策 → 科技股情绪承压 → 风险偏好下降 → 山寨和加密同步回调。NVDA产业链是全球AI叙事的锚，这个锚松动时，加密这种高beta资产很难独善其身。ETH 24小时跌4.75%、SOL跌2.57%，全市场已经在跌，这条新闻等于给空头递了弹药。

历史上看，每次中美科技管制升级（禁令、调查、制裁传闻），BTC短线下挫的概率都不低。这次市场本来就弱，情绪面偏空是明摆着的。

说白了，这个位置我不是看多派。BTC $59,604.4 这价位，方向没走出来之前，任何监管层面的坏消息都比好消息更影响价格。我的判断偏向谨慎观望，如果接下来12-24小时出现放量反弹收回失地，那说明利空被消化了；如果继续阴跌，这就是空头市场的又一记重锤。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试错的心态。

🚨 Breaking: The DragonX ($DRGX) development team has released a major update to the ObsidianDragon codebase!

Want to know what’s new in the latest commits? Here’s a detailed look at the key technical highlights and security upgrades:

1. Removing legacy Hush / Arrakis naming

Removed references to the legacy hush-arrakis-chain binary.
Updated legacy build scripts to prevent leftover files from being included in packages.
Improved the build logic for the daemon and launcher.
Further standardized DragonX’s independent naming conventions and build process.
Why it matters: This continues the effort to clean up legacy code, reinforcing DragonX’s independent Layer 1 architecture and build system.
2. Dual-key bootstrap signature verification

Pinned the automatic signing key and offline backup key.
Added support for two trusted public keys when verifying bootstrap signatures.
Fixed a compilation issue in the signature verification unit tests.
Why it matters: This is a major security upgrade at the wallet’s core, helping protect against tampering and supply chain risks.
3. Enhanced private chats and message security (v2.1.0)

A dedicated encryption key store for sensitive chats.
Support for locking and unlocking private conversations.
Message deletion and recovery mechanisms.
A simplified process for accepting or blocking contacts.
Chat identity fingerprints, along with clearer indicators of message delivery status.
Why it matters: This further improves the peer-to-peer private messaging experience in ObsidianDragon.
4. Wallet fund management and node stability

Background fund consolidation tasks now support real-time status tracking and manual stop controls.
Added legacy wallet recovery and backup safeguards during wallet migration. (Note: This is translated accurately to avoid confusing ObsidianDragon users about their recovery phrase.)
Balance displays now include indicators for pending change and synchronization status.
Improved node lifecycle management to prevent externally launched nodes from being shut down unexpectedly.
Optimized RPC busy handling and automatic reconnection.
Summary: This update goes far beyond interface improvements—it strengthens DragonX’s independent build infrastructure, core wallet security, encrypted messaging, and fund management. It demonstrates the team’s continued commitment to eliminating legacy dependencies and building a truly autonomous codebase.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling In: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve correctly spotted the trend and want to add to your position—but how? Going all in right away and piling on as your profits grow is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A common occurrence. The right approach is called pyramid scaling in.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping your average cost low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is all at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn gains into losses. Once you panic, your whole strategy falls apart.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why Being Able to Take Losses Is Key to Staying in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
Your account only draws down 20%, and a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re basically doomed.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right sequence is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

ETH upgrade fee plan stays in place | Fund outflows resume | Wait for test results

My stance on ETH is cautious observation. The Binance Square trending topic #EthereumGlamsterdamKeepsStorageFeeChange is gaining traction, and ETH is also among the top searches over the past six hours. The transcript of the November 26 Ethereum core developers’ meeting shows that the execution-layer team favors proceeding with the current EIP-8037 plan for the Hoodi test, without changing the specification in this round. The Hoodi testnet is targeted for December 15. The Ethereum website still says that the mainnet date has not been set, so “testing continues” does not mean that the new fee rules have been implemented on mainnet.

EIP-8037 addresses the permanent growth of state caused by creating accounts, new storage slots, and deployed code: it makes the Gas cost of creating state more closely reflect the long-term cost to nodes of storing that data, and measures it separately. This is not the same as the cost of sending ETH to an existing address. The Foundation previously replayed historical transactions and found that most contracts would be unaffected; some could be fixed simply by raising their Gas limits, while others that rely on fixed-Gas assumptions would need modification. The upgrade could help control the burden on nodes as throughput increases in the future, but it also carries short-term compatibility costs. Without Hoodi results, potential scaling improvements should not be presented as on-chain revenue or spot ETH buying today.

Institutional flows offer another perspective. Farside’s November 27 table of U.S. spot ETH fund performance shows combined net outflows of about $69.4 million, with the largest negative contribution from ETHA at about $57.3 million. These are figures from the updated table; when the data was previously missing, they could not have been treated as known. Fund flows and upgrade discussions occurring at the same time does not mean one caused the other. On the macro front, the Fed has made no new rate decision recently. Markets still need to watch interest rates and risk appetite, but meeting discussions should not be portrayed as a central-bank pivot. My view is that the technical roadmap is advancing, but fund-flow confirmation is still insufficient; positions should wait until both dimensions are clearer.

Price action also offers no reason to chase. I checked Kraken ETH/USD at about $1,652.87, with a rolling 24-hour open of $1,660.91, high of $1,741.30, and low of $1,632.16; the current price is below the open. In the short term, watch whether it can reclaim $1,705; around $1,740 is an overhead supply zone, and around $1,632 is the intraday low. If the four-hour price breaks below $1,632 and then fails on a retest, the recovery thesis is invalidated. If the Hoodi test is delayed, contract compatibility issues emerge, or fund outflows remain significant in subsequent reports, I would be less willing to participate even if the price briefly rebounds.

If I were trading this myself, I would not enter now; my only planned direction would be a leveraged-free spot long. I would enter in two tranches, using no more than 1% of total capital, only if a four-hour close holds above $1,705, a retest holds between $1,695 and $1,705, and the next fund data does not deteriorate significantly further. The first target is $1,740, where I would reduce the position by half; the second target is $1,780, where I would close the remainder in stages. After entry, I would stop out and close the position if a four-hour candle closes back below $1,670. If price first breaks below $1,632, I would cancel the plan. If none of these conditions are triggered, I would stay out and wait rather than present a hypothetical trade as an executed one.

Sources: Ethereum core developers’ meeting notes, EIP-8037, Ethereum Foundation developer guidance, Farside ETH fund table, Binance Square Trending Topics, Kraken ETH/USD market data.

【Upgrade Delayed—What Are ETH Funds Waiting For?】

I got burned in 2017. The most painful part wasn’t losing money; it was realizing that when someone says “there’s nothing wrong with the technology,” you have to ask who’s saying it and who bears the consequences. This ETH situation has a bit of that same feel.

The Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet has been delayed until December 15 due to security concerns. Core developers have decided to proceed with the controversial gas changes as originally proposed, without making adjustments. The significance of this signal isn’t the token price, but that when it came to balancing upgrade speed and security, developers chose not to rush into changes.

In practice, contract developers will need to recheck compatibility, users will see the testnet schedule disrupted, and ecosystem teams will have to absorb the costs of the delay. Does the business logic make sense? The delay sacrifices efficiency in exchange for avoiding the risk that gas-pricing changes could break existing contracts. But proceeding with the original proposal also shows that the team doesn’t want to delay indefinitely.

ETH is up 6% over the week and down 5% in 24 hours. The F&G index is still at 50, so the market isn’t exactly panicking; it seems more like everyone’s waiting for the dust to settle. It’s normal to feel tempted to act at a time like this, but don’t interpret a testnet upgrade as a buy signal.

This is my personal research and does not constitute investment advice. What Alpha have you spotted? Share in the comments: are you more worried about the upgrade being delayed, or about compatibility issues after the changes are made?

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scale Out of Profits: How to Lock In Gains While Letting Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss means cutting fear, while taking profit means cutting greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking approach I've been using.

[Three stages] Stage one: When it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage two: When it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), take off another third. Stage three: Let the rest ride with a trailing stop; if it drops below the moving average
or the previous low, exit and let your profits run.

[Why this works] Exit the whole position too early and you'll kick yourself; hold the whole position and you often watch your gains disappear, ending up back where you started.

title: 俄罗斯连卖十个月黄金，Tether 被冤枉了
subTitle:
黄金最近的故事里有个反转：一边是价格创纪录的波动，一边是央行在悄悄卖。据 PANews 11 月 27 日转述的统计，截至 9 月，土耳其、俄罗斯和阿塞拜疆的国家石油基金合计净卖出约 166 吨黄金，其中俄罗斯连续十个月减持，累计约 72 吨。沙特被怀疑也在卖金换美元，但没有实证。

被点名的还有一家不是央行的机构：USDT 的发行方。市场一度怀疑它在卖黄金筹钱，实际上它的黄金持仓不降反小幅上升。怀疑和证据是两回事，这次的统计里它是被冤枉的那个。

央行卖金值得认真对待，因为过去两年黄金大涨的叙事支柱之一就是央行持续买入。买盘一旦降温甚至转向，支撑逻辑就少了一根。报道里真正值得关注的判断是：卖盘固然在，买盘降温才是更要紧的信号。

对加密市场的投资者，这条新闻的价值在参照系。美元资产和黄金、BTC 都在争夺"抗通胀、去美元化"这个叙事的位置。如果央行对黄金的态度从囤转为卖，同样的叙事在 BTC 身上会怎么演绎，是下一个值得观察的问题。目前还没有证据表明机构在成规模卖出 BTC，两者走的是不同的剧本。

（信息来自 PANews 11 月 27 日报道，不构成投资建议）

translatedData.title: Russia sells gold for ten months straight; Tether was wrongly accused
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s a twist in gold’s recent story: prices have been swinging to record levels, while central banks have quietly been selling. According to figures cited by PANews on November 27, as of September, the sovereign oil funds of Türkiye, Russia, and Azerbaijan had collectively sold a net total of about 166 tonnes of gold. Russia had reduced its holdings for ten consecutive months, selling a cumulative total of about 72 tonnes. Saudi Arabia was also suspected of selling gold for dollars, but there was no evidence to support this.

Another institution named in the reports wasn’t a central bank: the issuer of USDT. The market once suspected it of selling gold to raise cash, but in fact its gold holdings edged up rather than down. Suspicion and evidence are two different things—and in these figures, it was wrongly accused.

以太坊市场深度分析：一千六百美元下方的坚守与隐忧

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二十八日凌晨四时，以太坊现货报价一千六百六十三美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之三点八。价格从一千六百七十二美元附近持续走低至一千六百五十四美元低位，反弹力度微弱。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现阴跌格局，成交量从七百零八万美元逐步萎缩至一百七十八万美元，量价齐跌的走势表明市场买盘意愿不足。

以太坊面临的压力来自多个方面。首先，美国现货以太坊ETF在十月和十一月累计流出超过二十八亿美元，其中十一月单月流出十三亿美元，机构资金的持续撤离对价格形成沉重压制。其次，大型持有者正在减持储备，包括超过一万一千九百枚以太坊被战略实体清算，叠加ICO时代的旧币抛售，进一步加剧了卖压。不过从积极面来看，格拉姆斯特丹测试网确认上线以及十万一千九百六十枚以太坊的鲸鱼质押买入，在一定程度上缓解了一千六百六十美元附近的下跌速度。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头排列。七周期EMA降至一千六百六十三美元，远低于二十五周期EMA的一千六百七十八美元和九十九周期EMA的一千六百九十一美元。简单移动均线同样确认弱势，七周期MA为一千六百六十三美元，而二十五周期MA为一千六百八十八美元，九十九周期MA为一千六百八十五美元，价格运行在所有主要均线下方。

MACD指标持续走弱，DIF线为负十一点五二，信号线为负十点六五，柱状图为负零点八六。虽然柱状图绝对值有所收窄，但MACD整体仍处于零轴下方的空头区域，短期内难以出现趋势性反转。RSI指标已进入超卖区域，六周期RSI降至三十点八七，这是一个较为极端的低位读数，历史上往往伴随短期技术性反弹。十二周期RSI为三十四点四六，二十四周期RSI为四十点三一，短周期与长周期的背离暗示市场可能正在接近短期底部。

布林带上轨为一千七百二十六美元，中轨为一千六百七十七美元，下轨为一千六百二十七美元。当前价格已跌破下轨，属于超卖状态。KDJ指标中K线降至三十九点四七，D线为四十三点六三，J线降至三十一点一六，三线向下发散，短期动能偏弱。威廉指标降至负八十八点八五，深度超卖区域。综合因子统计显示十五个因子中有八个发出做多信号，但综合指标给出做空信号，历史胜率为百分之七十八点五七，显示空头目前仍占优势。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.

以太坊市场深度分析：一千六百美元下方的坚守与隐忧

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二十八日凌晨四时，以太坊现货报价一千六百六十三美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之三点八。价格从一千六百七十二美元附近持续走低至一千六百五十四美元低位，反弹力度微弱。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现阴跌格局，成交量从七百零八万美元逐步萎缩至一百七十八万美元，量价齐跌的走势表明市场买盘意愿不足。

以太坊面临的压力来自多个方面。首先，美国现货以太坊ETF在十月和十一月累计流出超过二十八亿美元，其中十一月单月流出十三亿美元，机构资金的持续撤离对价格形成沉重压制。其次，大型持有者正在减持储备，包括超过一万一千九百枚以太坊被战略实体清算，叠加ICO时代的旧币抛售，进一步加剧了卖压。不过从积极面来看，格拉姆斯特丹测试网确认上线以及十万一千九百六十枚以太坊的鲸鱼质押买入，在一定程度上缓解了一千六百六十美元附近的下跌速度。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头排列。七周期EMA降至一千六百六十三美元，远低于二十五周期EMA的一千六百七十八美元和九十九周期EMA的一千六百九十一美元。简单移动均线同样确认弱势，七周期MA为一千六百六十三美元，而二十五周期MA为一千六百八十八美元，九十九周期MA为一千六百八十五美元，价格运行在所有主要均线下方。

MACD指标持续走弱，DIF线为负十一点五二，信号线为负十点六五，柱状图为负零点八六。虽然柱状图绝对值有所收窄，但MACD整体仍处于零轴下方的空头区域，短期内难以出现趋势性反转。RSI指标已进入超卖区域，六周期RSI降至三十点八七，这是一个较为极端的低位读数，历史上往往伴随短期技术性反弹。十二周期RSI为三十四点四六，二十四周期RSI为四十点三一，短周期与长周期的背离暗示市场可能正在接近短期底部。

布林带上轨为一千七百二十六美元，中轨为一千六百七十七美元，下轨为一千六百二十七美元。当前价格已跌破下轨，属于超卖状态。KDJ指标中K线降至三十九点四七，D线为四十三点六三，J线降至三十一点一六，三线向下发散，短期动能偏弱。威廉指标降至负八十八点八五，深度超卖区域。综合因子统计显示十五个因子中有八个发出做多信号，但综合指标给出做空信号，历史胜率为百分之七十八点五七，显示空头目前仍占优势。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪整体偏悲观。一方面，格拉姆斯特丹升级的安全审计发现了约两百个软件和桥接漏洞，测试网计划于十二月十五日部署，但安全问题给市场信心蒙上阴影。另一方面，以太坊ETF的持续赎回反映出机构投资者对以太坊短期前景的谨慎态度。在比特币主导市场资金流向的背景下，以太坊作为高贝塔资产承受了更大的下行压力。

不过从中长期来看，以太坊仍有多重利好因素。格拉姆斯特丹测试网的推进展示了以太坊核心团队的开发节奏并未放缓，链上质押活动的增加也表明长期持有者对以太坊生态的信心依然存在。当前价格已显著低于多条均线的成本区域，若宏观环境出现改善或ETF资金流出现拐点，以太坊可能迎来较强的技术性修复行情。投资者需密切关注一千六百二十七美元布林下轨的支撑有效性，以及美联储十二月议息会议对市场风险偏好的影响。

周六午间，上午那一刀都挨稳了吧？BTC从24小时高点62206.9一路捅到58750，成交额12.45B USDT。周末缩量阴跌的老剧本今天没上演——这是拿真钱砸出来的行情，-2.304%，一点不掺水。

弹回59969.5就开始喊反转的，先照照镜子：价格还压在轴心60283.37下面。多头翻身第一步是收回60283.37，第二步才轮到日线卖点61816.73。现在连第一步的影子都没有。

最讽刺的是资金费率：跌成这样，BTC费率依然是+5.633e-05，ETH也还是正的1.947e-05。翻译一下：多头还在自费排队等解套。投降的多头才是好多头，现在一个都没投降，这轮下跌大概率没走完。

ETH惨上加惨：-3.976%，24小时低点1632.88，离日线买点1611.37只差一口气。BTC跌2.304%，ETH跌3.976%，强弱一目了然。想止跌，先在1611.37上方站住；想反转，先拿下1733.23。一件都没干成，就别急着讲补涨的故事。

防守组倒是清晰：BNB只跌1.575%，日线买点542.47就踩在脚下；XRP跌1.167%，蹲在0.92上方没破位。资金躲进「跌不动」的资产，这是标准的防御姿态——别把抗跌当进攻信号看。

午间结论：空头信号明显。BTC跌破58750，下一站直接看日线买点58359.83；那里再失守，短期下方没有像样支撑，下行风险放大。反过来说，收回60283.37，我第一个改口——认错这件事，我向来比你们手快。

最后一句毒舌关怀：下跌途中接飞刀，拼的不是胆量，是价位。58359.83附近的支撑反应值得盯，但盯归盯，别把「看着便宜」当成理由。便宜的东西，可以更便宜。
